title: CV-OPD: Contrastive Vision On-policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.13264v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) reveals versatility and convenience during VLM post-training, providing dense supervision for student from teacher. However, we observed an anomaly that the distilled VLM could still answer the questions accurately even when the related visual regions were masked or replaced with noise. Building on this observation, our quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that OPD, which uses the answer as a hint, has failed to teach students to genuinely seek out and rely on visual evidence. Our theoretical analysis suggests that this failure arises from a shortcut enabled by the lack of visual constraints during distillation. translated_abstract: 在策略蒸馏在视觉语言模型后训练中展现出多功能性与便利性，能够为学生模型提供来自教师模型的密集监督。然而，我们观察到一种异常现象：蒸馏得到的视觉语言模型即使在相关视觉区域被遮蔽或替换为噪声的情况下，仍然能够准确回答问题。基于这一观察，我们的定量与定性实验表明，以答案作为提示的在策略蒸馏未能教会学生模型真正地寻找并依赖视觉证据。我们的理论分析指出，这种失败源于蒸馏过程中缺乏视觉约束而产生的捷径。为解决该问题，我们提出了对比视觉在策略蒸馏，该方法在以相同的学生前缀为条件的情况下，比较由正样本裁剪与负样本裁剪所诱导的教师分布，并通过基于间隔的对比约束来增强优化，从而（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现传统在策略蒸馏会让学生视觉语言模型走捷径、未能真正依赖视觉证据（即使视觉区域被遮挡仍能答对问题），并提出CV-OPD方法，通过在相同学生前缀条件下对比正负视觉裁剪所诱导的教师分布，并引入基于间隔的对比约束，迫使学生模型真正利用视觉信息进行推理。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that on-policy distillation enables student VLMs to exploit shortcuts and fail to genuinely rely on visual evidence (they still answer correctly even when visual regions are masked), and proposes CV-OPD, which compares teacher distributions induced by positive and negative visual crops under the same student prefix with a margin-based contrastive constraint to enforce genuine visual grounding.
